Get KZS Teams

Source: R/kzs.R
kzs_teams.Rd

Teams entered in a competition.

Endpoint: GET https://api.kzs.si/api/v1/public/teams/

Usage

kzs_teams(competition_id)

Arguments

competition_id

(required) Competition id (competition_id in kzs_competitions): one per competition per season, e.g. 579 (men's first league 2025/26).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Teams entered in a competition. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py kzs_teams):

col_nametypedescription
competition_idintegerCompetition id: one per competition per season (men's first league 2025/26 = 579, 2026/27 = 608).
team_idintegerTeam-application id: the team's registration (entry) for the season; play-by-play teamApplicationId is the same key space.
team_application_idintegerTeam-application id: the team's registration (entry) for the season; play-by-play teamApplicationId is the same key space.
club_idintegerClub id: the club across seasons and categories (Ilirija = 16). No captured route is keyed by it.
club_memberlogicalTrue when the club is a KZS member (false on nested copies that omit it).
team_internal_rankingcharacterThe club's internal team letter for the category (A = first team, B = second team).
categorycharacterAge category: ABSOLUTE (senior) or U8-U23 / ANY (code table in kzs-returns.md).
rankcharacterTier: FIRST-FOURTH or TOURNAMENT (code table).
gendercharacterMALE or FEMALE.
sport_hall_idintegerSport hall (venue) id. /sportHalls/{id} is in the site bundle, not captured.
sport_hall_namecharacterName of the venue (sports hall) where the game is played or the team is based.
namecharacterTeam name for the season (sponsor name included).
codecharacterTeam 3-letter code.
home_jersey_colorcharacterHome jersey colour, hex '#RRGGBB'.
guest_jersey_colorcharacterAway jersey colour, hex.
logo_uuidcharacterTeam logo: image file id, served at https://api.kzs.si/public/images/{uuid}.
home_team_colorcharacterHome colour, hex.
guest_team_colorcharacterAway colour, hex.
short_namecharacterTeam short name (” when none).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in kzs_seasons().

See also

Other KZS Functions: kzs_box_score(), kzs_competition(), kzs_competitions(), kzs_match(), kzs_matches(), kzs_pbp(), kzs_pbp_players(), kzs_period_scores(), kzs_phases(), kzs_player(), kzs_player_leaderboard(), kzs_player_stats(), kzs_playing_days(), kzs_roster(), kzs_rounds(), kzs_score_changes(), kzs_seasons(), kzs_standings(), kzs_team(), kzs_team_box_score(), kzs_team_general(), kzs_team_leaderboard()
